scope: Tadla irrigated perimeter (Beni Amir / Beni Moussa), semi-arid Morocco
water_source: FAO Irrigation & Drainage Paper 56 (Allen et al., 1998) - crop water needs are ESTIMATE ranges for comparable climates; not measured Tadla values
windows_source: FAO EcoCrop / ORMVAT agronomic context - APPROXIMATE planting windows, pending agronomy SME review
candidates_note: rotation_candidate=true marks the 11 annual candidates (13 P0 crops minus 3 perennial trees, plus the berseem rotation candidate). Every vocabulary crop carries a family so any legal history entry scores without KeyError; families follow standard botany (standard botanical family classification (Angiosperm Phylogeny Group IV)).

sugar_beet.family_note: beet family (ex-Chenopodiaceae) - beet cyst nematode host

anise.water_note: aromatic crop - extension estimate, not in FAO-56 table
